notes: WArmy 0.4.14 — fixes custom-provider chat failing with "object is not iterable": the process-isolated chat engine no longer proxies its synchronous compression/budget callbacks across processes, and streamed responses are consumed as complete payloads, so chat and call-chain fallback work for every provider; fetching a provider model list now validates chat usability with a minimal probe (insufficient balance/quota is not a failure, while invalid keys/endpoints block adding the provider); abnormal-session badges show only the exclamation mark in the theme accent color (no overlapping unread count); in the model management card, enabling Smart Mode greys out and disables the call-chain section and the label drops its parenthetical; privacy gate hardening (no hardcoded workspace paths in scripts). Verified by the full gate suite: 78 gates x 3 consecutive clean rounds (234 checks, 0 failures, 0 flakes). The in-app updater downloads only changed blocks with unchanged SHA-256 verification.
